_meta.game: Zeliard, MS-DOS English (Sierra 1990) balance. Japanese-version differences are in japanese_balance.json.

units.frame: One cavern main-loop iteration: speed_const*4 PIT ticks at 236.70 Hz. Default speed_const 5 => 84.5 ms (11.83 frames/s). F9 digit d => speed_const = 10-d (digit 9 = 4 ticks = 59 fps, digit 0 = 40 ticks = 5.9 fps).
units.hp: Internal 16-bit hit points. The LIFE bar draws 8 HP per pixel; 800 HP = full bar.

starting_state.note: King Felishika gives 1000 gold on the first audience (see story.json/towns.json). Evidence: stdply.bin bytes 0x85..0xE8.

level_up_effects: max HP set from the table and current HP = max HP (full heal)
spell max charges set from the per-level table (spells.json) or +2 each when L >= 16; current charges = max (full refill)
XP overflow cap: if remaining XP >= xp_table[min(new_level, 15)] then XP = that value - 1 (you can never bank a second level-up)
sword damage bonus rises (floor(level/2), see items.json damage formula)
evidence: 217KENJP.asm lines 470-560 (labels palette_* are misnamed; they implement the level-up)
217KENJP.bin DS:A28C xp table, DS:A380 level rows

sage.level_cap_rule: A Sage only levels you up while hero_level < cap[sage_id-1], cap table DS:A2AC = [3,6,9,11,13,15,18,255]. At or above the cap he answers with tier 4.
sage.first_visit: One-time introduction speech (bitmask 0xE5: +128 Muralla ... +1 Pureza). Sages 2..8 teach their spell in it (sets learned flag, selects the spell). Text verbatim in towns.json.

see_power.preamble: I shall call upon the Spirits and their powers.....

tiers.text: Your experience is lacking. Persevere in your quest.
I can see the faint light of the Spirits in you. You must endure a little longer.

tiers.condition: xp >= need and level < sage cap
tiers.text: The light of the Spirits is bursting forth within you. / Indeed, your power has grown.

tiers.condition: xp >= need and level >= sage cap
tiers.text: I can no longer impart the power of the Spirits to you. Continue on your quest. You will soon find others to help you.

see_power.evidence: 217KENJP.asm check_hp_exp_tier (lines 380-430) and blessing texts at kenjp_blessing_text_ptrs
see_power.community_wording_note: Community quotes ('You must persevere') paraphrase tier 0; the verbatim DOS strings are above.

record_experience.text: I shall record your experiences./ ... Place is saved on user disk. Will you continue your quest?
record_experience.effect: Asks for an up-to-8-character name and writes the 256-byte player record to NAME.USR (INT 21h create/write/close). Save byte 0xC4 records the town. The DOS build never updates 0xC5 (last sage), see death rules.

other_lines.greeting: How can I help you, Brave One?
other_lines.again: Is there anything else I can do for you?
other_lines.prayer: Oh, Holy Spirits, purify my thoughts and grant me strength.

xp_sources.monsters: Per-type XP byte from the world's EAI header (enemies.json), added on kill.
xp_sources.death: Dying ADDS (127 - 2*level) mod 256 XP (8-bit arithmetic: level 0 -> +127, level 63 -> +1, level 64 -> +255, level 100 -> +183).

dos_rule.trigger: hero_HP == 0 at the end of a cavern frame and hero_invincibility (0x7F) not set
dos_rule.animation: Hero collapses, blinks (~30 frames), screen fades.
penalties: XP += (127 - 2*level) mod 256 (a gain, not a loss)
dos_rule.respawn: Sage hut of the town in save byte 0xC5 'last sage visited'. The DOS build NEVER writes 0xC5 (initial 0x81), so you always respawn at Muralla (Sage Marid). Kioku Feather uses the same byte and therefore always returns to Muralla.
dos_rule.special_case: If save byte 0x49 is non-zero at death, there is no penalty and 0xC5 is set to 0x80 so you wake in Felishika Castle ('Brave knight, you have awakened. When you fell at the hand of Jashiin, the Spirits brought you here...'). This is the scripted Jashiin encounter path; see story.json.
evidence: binary search of all chunks: the only write to [00C5] is 'mov byte [00C5],80h' in 200FIGHT at file offset 0x39B8
TCRF DOS page: 'Never updates last sage the player visited'

japanese_rule.respawn: last Sage spoken to (0xC5 is updated in the PC-88/X1 version)
japanese_rule.source: TCRF Zeliard (DOS) revisional differences; HG101 Zeliard article
japanese_rule.confidence: medium (secondary sources, consistent with each other)

recovery.cavern_regen: +2 HP every 16 frames while HP < max (about 1.35 s at default speed). Runs every frame in caverns, standing still or not; can overshoot max by 1 when HP is odd. Counter resets on damage/scene changes. Not in the Japanese versions.
recovery.red_potion: Cavern pickup (drop code 8 / hidden in walls/chests): healing_potion_timer += 10 -> +8 HP per frame for 10 frames = +80 HP.
recovery.blue_potion: Cavern pickup (drop code 9): healing_potion_timer += maxHP/8 + 1 -> +8 HP per frame until full (timer cleared when HP reaches max).
recovery.church: Full HP and all spell charges, free (Muralla, Esco).
recovery.inn: Full HP and all spell charges for the town's inn price (towns.json).

hazards.hazard_tiles: Four tile ids per tileset (tileset table at DS:8020) hurt on contact: damage per frame = [1,1,4,8,20,20,20,20,20][cavern_level-1] unless Pirika Shoes are equipped (ida/fight.asm step_on_aggressive_ground, byte_7516).
hazards.heat: cavern_level 7 (Caliente/Reaccion/Correr) without the Asbestos Cape equipped: 15 damage every 64 frames with the message 'It’s too hot !!'. Timer (temperature_timer) only counts while unprotected in level 7.
hazards.ice: cavern_level 4: without Ruzeria Shoes the floor is slippery (hero slides).
hazards.slopes: without Silkarn Shoes the hero slides down slopes.

currency.almas: 16-bit, saturates at 65535. Enemy drops: 1, 10 or 100 almas objects (drop codes 4, 5, 11). Also some wall stashes ('Wall, 100 almas').

exchange_almas_to_gold._note: Gold received per alma. Authoritative values and bank program details are in towns.json (213BANKP). Values below are the DOS rates published by TCRF and the community, which agree with each other.
exchange_almas_to_gold.llama_note: Llama is 4 almas : 2 gold (i.e. 1 gold per 2 almas).

currency.bank: Deposit / withdraw / exchange almas / check balance. Bank balance survives death. Amount entry: Up/Down +/-10, Left/Right +/-1 (manual). See towns.json for limits and dialogue.

sword_damage_formula.formula: d = sword_base[sword] + floor(level/2); if d > 255 -> 255; d = d * (sabre_oil_count + 1), capped at 255; downward thrust (jump + Up+Down + attack): d = min(255, d*2). Monster hp -= d; hp <= 0 kills.

story_progression._note: Map-file ids (MPxx) for boss arenas are verified from the MDT descriptors' boss_ai field; cavern names come from the save-flag documentation (ida/common.inc, TCRF notes). The exact cavern<->MDT assignment and door graph is owned by game/data/world/.

story_progression.tears: Count byte 0xA0 (0..9). One per main boss: Cangrejo, Pulpo, Pollo, Agar, Vista, Tarso, Dragon, Alguien (per-cavern 'Collected a Tear' flags 0x03 b5, 0x0B b3, 0x13 b1, 0x1C b4, 0x24 b2, 0x2D b4, 0x36 b7, 0x45 b6) + Jashiin. Paguro gives the Elf Crest, not a Tear.
